connectorUiConfig.title: Feodotracker Botnet C2 Feed (CCF Push)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
Ingests botnet C2 indicators from [abuse.ch Feodotracker](https://feodotracker.abuse.ch/) into Microsoft Sentinel using the Codeless Connector Framework Push mode.

**Table:** `FeodoTracker_CL` — C2 server IPs, ports, malware families, status, and geolocation.

sampleQueries.query:
FeodoTracker_CL
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50

FeodoTracker_CL
| where status == 'online'
| summarize Count=dcount(ip_address) by malware
| sort by Count desc

dataTypes.name: FeodoTracker_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
FeodoTracker_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

value:
FeodoTracker_CL
| summarize LastLogReceived = max(TimeGenerated)
| project IsConnected = LastLogReceived > ago(7d)

instructionSteps.title: 1. Deploy Push Connector Resources
instructionSteps.description: Click the button below to auto-provision the DCE, DCR, custom table, Entra app, client secret, and RBAC assignment.

parameters.content:
#### Automated Configuration
Clicking **Deploy** creates a Log Analytics table, Data Collection Rule (DCR), Data Collection Endpoint (DCE), and an Entra application with a client secret. The Entra app is granted Monitoring Metrics Publisher role on the DCR.

instructionSteps.title: 2. Configure Your Sender Application
instructionSteps.description: Use the following connection details to configure the Send-ThreatIntel.py script.

parameters.label: Application (Client) ID
parameters.placeholder: Deploy push connector to get the Application ID

parameters.label: Client Secret
parameters.placeholder: Deploy push connector to get the Client Secret

parameters.label: Data Collection Endpoint URI
parameters.placeholder: Deploy push connector to get the DCE URI

parameters.label: Data Collection Rule Immutable ID
parameters.placeholder: Deploy push connector to get the DCR Immutable ID

parameters.content:
#### Run the Sender Script
Set the connection credentials as environment variables and run:
```bash
export CCF_TENANT_ID="<Tenant ID>"
export CCF_CLIENT_ID="<Application ID>"
export CCF_CLIENT_SECRET="<Client Secret>"
export CCF_DCE_URI="<DCE URI>"
export CCF_DCR_ID="<DCR Immutable ID>"
python3 Send-ThreatIntel.py
```
Data appears in `FeodoTracker_CL` within 5-10 minutes.
